snippet.title: Surgical Strike Longplay - Full Playthrough on Sega CD (US Version)
snippet.description:
This is an uncommented longplay of the full motion video (FMV) based game Surgical Strike on Sega CD / Mega-CD. The Sega CD exclusive interactive movie was developed by The Code Monkeys and published by Sega in 1995.

Watch the full playlist of FMV based Sega CD games: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W3TdW-q5P98&list=PL1CCqR-KGT2su5SwG9q9i-za-EAQsh-Qk

RetroLongplay 24/7 Livestream: https://www.twitch.tv/retrolongplay

This longplay recording was created using savestates and it's optimized for the 24/7 RetroLongplay stream.
